verdict.rationale: Unity provides documented command-line/headless build support (batch mode, headless player args), Editor command-line arguments for automation, an official Unity CLI explicitly for CI pipelines/build agents, and Unity Build Automation for continuous integration across platforms including iOS — together covering the full headless build/export-in-CI workflow. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community confirmation of CI pipelines working smoothly (one community report even describes CI licensing pain), so corroboration beyond vendor docs is thin.
